display_scenes_trimesh: display a dictionary of trimesh Scene objects in a tiled pyglet GUI window with keyboard controls
display_scenes_numpy: display a dictionary of numpy array images in a tiled pyglet GUI window using glooey
display_scenes_generator: display scenes from a generator that yields dictionaries of trimesh scenes for animated playback
from_opengl_transform: convert an OpenGL camera transform matrix by applying a 180 degree X-axis rotation
numpy_to_image: convert a numpy array to a pyglet image by encoding it as a PNG in memory
